# yii3-seo

Next.js-inspired, Yii3-native typed SEO metadata. One declarative `Metadata`
object per page; site-wide `MetadataDefaults` merged in. Namespace:
`Rasuvaeff\Yii3Seo`.

## Install

```bash
composer require rasuvaeff/yii3-seo
```

## Rules

- `SeoInjection` implements `LayoutParametersInjectionInterface` + `MetaTagsInjectionInterface` + `LinkTagsInjectionInterface` — register it in `WebViewRenderer::injections`. It is then available to layouts as `$seo`. Package DI also adds a service reset hook so request-local metadata does not leak in reusable runtimes.
- Call `setMetadata(Metadata)` per request (via `SeoMetadataEvent` from an action) before the renderer fires.
- `MetadataDefaults` is provided via the `rasuvaeff/yii3-seo` → `defaults` DI parameter; it is merged with the page `Metadata`.
- Title resolution: page `Title::of('X')` + defaults `Title::template('%s | Acme', default: 'Acme')` → `X | Acme`. `Title::absolute('X')` bypasses the template. No page title → defaults `default`.
- `metadataBase` (in defaults) resolves relative crawler-facing URLs: canonical, hreflang, `og:url`, `og:image`, `twitter:image`. Relative URL without base throws `InvalidArgumentException`. Icons/manifest are emitted as-is (browser-resolved).
- Fallback cascade (on by default): `og:title`/`og:description` ← page title/description; `twitter:title`/`description`/`image` ← OpenGraph. Explicit values win.
- Field merge: `openGraph`/`twitter` inherit unset fields from defaults; `applicationName`/`generator`/`themeColor`/`colorScheme`/`robots`/`icons`/`verification` are page-or-default; `jsonLd`/`other` concatenate defaults + page; `keywords`/`authors`/`creator`/`publisher`/`manifest` are page-only; `alternates` is page-only too, except that a configured `selfCanonical` fills in a missing canonical from the request path while keeping the page's hreflang `languages`.
- `MetadataResolver::resolve()` is the single source of merge/fallback behavior and returns immutable `ResolvedMetadata`. Relative crawler-facing URLs are resolved later by the rendering adapter.
- `<title>` and JSON-LD are NOT registered by the meta/link interfaces — render them from the automatically injected `$seo` layout parameter via `getTitle()` and `getJsonLdHtml()`. Do NOT listen to `Yiisoft\View\Event\WebView\PageBegin` to avoid it: `WebViewEvent::getView()` is `@internal` to Yiisoft.
- Config groups shipped: `di`, `params`, `events-web`. The `SeoMetadataEvent` → `SetSeoMetadataEventHandler` listener is registered automatically — do NOT repeat it in the application. `HttpApplicationRunner` reads `events-web` with `RecursiveMerge`, so package listeners merge with the application's instead of colliding.
- Sitemaps are a separate, head-independent surface: `SitemapUrl` + `SitemapProviderInterface` in, `Sitemap`/`SitemapIndex` chunks out. Every sitemap URL is resolved against the same `metadataBase`; XML escaping is `XMLWriter`'s job, never string concatenation.
- All URL/identifier validation throws `InvalidArgumentException` (message without trailing period).

## API

### Metadata (page object)

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Seo\Metadata;

new Metadata(
    title: 'Home',                 // string|Title; string -> Title::of()
    description: 'Desc',
    keywords: ['a', 'b'],
    authors: [new Author(name: 'Alice', url: 'https://example.com/alice')],
    applicationName: 'App', generator: 'Yii', creator: 'C', publisher: 'P',
    themeColor: '#fff', colorScheme: 'dark light',
    robots: Robots::index(),
    alternates: new Alternates(canonical: '/page', languages: ['en' => '/en']),
    openGraph: new OpenGraph(type: 'article', images: [new OgImage(url: '/og.jpg')]),
    twitter: new TwitterCard(card: 'summary_large_image', site: '@site'),
    icons: new Icons(icon: '/favicon.ico'),
    manifest: '/site.webmanifest',
    verification: new Verification(google: 'token'),
    jsonLd: [JsonLd::fromArray(['@type' => 'WebPage'])],
    other: [MetaTag::name('rating', 'general')],
)
```

### MetadataDefaults (site-wide, in params)

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Seo\MetadataDefaults;

new MetadataDefaults(
    metadataBase: 'https://example.com',     // validated absolute URL
    title: Title::template('%s | Acme', default: 'Acme'),
    applicationName: null, generator: null, themeColor: null, colorScheme: null,
    robots: null,
    openGraph: new OpenGraph(siteName: 'Acme', locale: 'en_US'),
    twitter: new TwitterCard(card: 'summary_large_image', site: '@acme'),
    icons: null, verification: null, jsonLd: [], other: [],
    selfCanonical: null,                     // SelfCanonical policy; requires metadataBase
)
```

### SelfCanonical / SelfCanonicalMiddleware (opt-in self-canonical URLs)

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Seo\SelfCanonical;
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Seo\SelfCanonicalMiddleware;

SelfCanonical::enabled()                      // path only, every query parameter dropped
SelfCanonical::keepingQuery('page', 'sort')   // keep an allow-list, in the listed order
new SelfCanonical(['page'])

// config/common/params.php: add SelfCanonicalMiddleware::class to 'middlewares'
// It records the request path via SeoInjection::setRequestPath().
```

Rules: authority (scheme/host/port) is never read — canonical URLs are anchored
to `metadataBase`; allow-list order beats request order so the canonical URL is
stable; array-valued parameters (`?tag[]=a`) are always dropped; an explicit
`Alternates::canonical` wins and page hreflang `languages` are preserved;
`MetadataDefaults` throws when `selfCanonical` is set without `metadataBase`;
without the middleware no request path is recorded and nothing happens.

### Title

```php
Title::of('Home')                                  // template applied
Title::absolute('Home')                            // template bypassed
Title::template('%s | Acme', default: 'Acme')      // defaults only
```

### Alternates / OpenGraph / OgImage / TwitterCard

```php
new Alternates(canonical: '/page', languages: ['en' => '/en', 'x-default' => '/'])
new OpenGraph(title: null, description: null, type: null, url: '/p', siteName: 'S', locale: 'en_US', images: [/* OgImage */])  // type: null inherits defaults, renders og:type "website" if unset
new OgImage(url: '/og.jpg', width: 1200, height: 630, alt: 'Alt', type: 'image/jpeg')
new TwitterCard(card: null, site: '@s', creator: '@c', title: null, description: null, images: [])  // card: summary|summary_large_image|app|player; inherits defaults, renders "summary_large_image" if unset
```

### Robots

```php
Robots::index()        // index, follow
Robots::noindex(); Robots::nofollow(); Robots::none(); Robots::noarchive();
new Robots(['noindex', 'nosnippet'])
Robots::index()->withNoSnippet()->withNoImageIndex()
    ->withMaxSnippet(-1)->withMaxImagePreview('large')->withMaxVideoPreview(30)
    ->withGoogleBot('noindex')   // separate <meta name="googlebot">
```

### Icons / Verification / Author / MetaTag / JsonLd

```php
new Icons(icon: '/favicon.ico', shortcut: '/favicon.ico', apple: '/apple.png', other: [new Icon(rel: 'mask-icon', url: '/safari.svg')])
new Verification(google: 'g', yandex: 'y', bing: 'b', other: ['me' => 'm'])
new Author(name: 'Alice', url: 'https://example.com/alice')
MetaTag::name('rating', 'general'); MetaTag::property('fb:app_id', '123'); MetaTag::httpEquiv('x-ua-compatible', 'IE=edge');
JsonLd::fromArray(['@context' => 'https://schema.org', '@type' => 'WebPage'])->toJson()   // JSON_HEX_TAG encoded
JsonLd::fromArray([...])->toHtml()   // full <script type="application/ld+json"> element
```

### SeoInjection

```php
$injection->setMetadata(Metadata $m): void
$injection->clear(): void
$injection->getLayoutParameters(): array // ['seo' => $injection]
$injection->getResolvedMetadata(): ResolvedMetadata
$injection->getTitle(): string          // resolved <title> for layout
$injection->getMetaTags(): list<Meta>   // auto-injected by WebViewRenderer
$injection->getLinkTags(): array<Link>  // auto-injected by WebViewRenderer
$injection->getJsonLdHtml(): string     // render in layout manually
$injection->setRequestPath(?string)     // self-canonical input; SelfCanonicalMiddleware calls it
$injection->clear() / reset()           // drops metadata AND request path (reusable runtimes)
```

Resolution is lazy and cached: `getResolvedMetadata()` resolves once and returns
the same instance until `setMetadata()`, `setRequestPath()` or `clear()` is called.

### MetadataResolver / ResolvedMetadata

```php
$resolved = (new MetadataResolver())->resolve(
    metadata: new Metadata(title: 'Page'),
    defaults: new MetadataDefaults(title: Title::template('%s | Brand')),
);
$resolved->getTitle();      // Page | Brand
$resolved->getOpenGraph();  // field-level merged + title/description fallback
$resolved->getTwitter();    // field-level merged + OpenGraph fallback
$resolved->toArray();       // normalized array for APIs/SPA/preview/debugging
```

`toArray()` resolves canonical, hreflang, `og:url` and image URLs against
`metadataBase` (throws `InvalidArgumentException` on a relative URL without a
base), keeps icon/manifest URLs as configured, omits nulls and empty
collections, and always includes `title`.

### MetadataValidator / MetadataValidationResult / MetadataIssue

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Seo\MetadataValidator;

$result = (new MetadataValidator())->validate($resolved);
$result->isValid();      // true when no errors; warnings are advisory
$result->hasErrors();
$result->hasIssues();
$result->getIssues();    // list<MetadataIssue>
$result->getErrors();
$result->getWarnings();

$issue->getSeverity();   // MetadataIssueSeverity::Error | ::Warning
$issue->getCode();       // e.g. 'title.missing'
$issue->getMessage();
$issue->isError();
```

Never throws. Codes: `title.missing` (error), `title.too_long`,
`description.missing`, `description.too_short`, `description.too_long`,
`canonical.missing`, `canonical.og_url_mismatch` (error), `url.unresolvable`
(error), `image.missing`, `image.alt_missing`, `image.dimensions_missing`,
`robots.conflicting` (error), `other.duplicate`. Everything not marked as error
is a warning. Title/description lengths are advisory (60 / 50-160 characters).

### Event wiring (automatic; shown for reference)

```php
// Shipped as config/events-web.php and merged by yiisoft/config — do NOT repeat it.
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Seo\SeoMetadataEvent;
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Seo\SetSeoMetadataEventHandler;

return [
    SeoMetadataEvent::class => [[SetSeoMetadataEventHandler::class, '__invoke']],
];

// In action: inject EventDispatcherInterface, dispatch
$this->eventDispatcher->dispatch(new SeoMetadataEvent(metadata: new Metadata(title: 'Home')));
```

### DI wiring

```php
// config/common/di.php
WebViewRenderer::class => [
    '__construct()' => [
        'injections' => [CsrfViewInjection::class, SeoInjection::class],
    ],
],
```

### Layout

```php
<?php use Yiisoft\Html\Html; ?>
<title><?= Html::encode($seo->getTitle()) ?></title>
<?= $seo->getJsonLdHtml() ?>
```

### Sitemap (crawlability)

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Seo\{ChangeFrequency, Sitemap, SitemapFileExporter, SitemapImage, SitemapIndex,
    SitemapIndexEntry, SitemapLimits, SitemapProviderInterface, SitemapResponseFactory, SitemapUrl};

final class ProductSitemapProvider implements SitemapProviderInterface
{
    public function getUrls(): iterable            // yield, never return an array
    {
        yield new SitemapUrl(
            loc: '/products/1',                    // relative -> resolved against metadataBase
            lastModified: new DateTimeImmutable('2026-07-21T10:00:00+00:00'),
            changeFrequency: ChangeFrequency::Weekly,
            priority: 0.8,                          // 0.0-1.0, one decimal
            images: [new SitemapImage('/images/1.jpg')],
            alternates: ['de-DE' => '/de/produkte/1'],   // same locale rules as Alternates
        );
    }
}

// Stream a document (SitemapDocumentInterface::toChunks(): iterable<string>)
foreach ((new Sitemap($provider->getUrls(), 'https://example.com'))->toChunks() as $chunk) {
    echo $chunk;
}

// Serve it from a route (PSR-17 factories from the container; body is php://temp)
$response = $responseFactory->create(new Sitemap($provider->getUrls(), 'https://example.com'));

// Export to files, enforcing 50 000 URLs and 50 MiB per file
$paths = (new SitemapFileExporter('https://example.com', new SitemapLimits(), '/'))
    ->export($provider->getUrls(), '/var/www/public');
```

Rules:

- One file -> `sitemap.xml` (a `<urlset>`). More than one -> `sitemap-1.xml` … `sitemap-N.xml` plus a `sitemap.xml` index. `export()` returns the written paths in write order and deletes nothing.
- `SitemapLimits` accepts stricter values only; above 50 000 / 52 428 800 it throws. A single URL that cannot fit the byte limit throws instead of producing an over-limit file.
- A document built from a `Generator` renders once; pass an array to re-render.
- `SitemapFileExporter` is in the package DI config and inherits `metadataBase` from `MetadataDefaults`; `publicPath` comes from `rasuvaeff/yii3-seo` → `sitemap` → `publicPath` and prefixes the index entries.
- `lastmod` is a `DateTimeImmutable` rendered in W3C datetime (`DateTimeInterface::ATOM`). The exporter never stamps a timestamp itself — pass one to `export()` if the index needs `lastmod`.
